tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an HTML document or a URL to a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WEBP file. Returns a temporary download URL (valid ~2 days).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all saved HTML templates for the account.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get the raw HTML content of a template by its slug.

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a new reusable HTML template.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update the name and/or HTML content of an existing template.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a template by its slug.

tools.name: generate_from_template
tools.description: Render a saved template to HTML, PDF, PNG, JPEG or WEBP. Document formats return a temporary download URL; html returns the rendered markup. Pass template variables and any conversion option as extra properties.

tools.name: credits_usage
tools.description: Get the current credit usage for the account (remaining, total, used).

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: List the available PDFShift plans and their pricing (credits, price, overage, monthly/yearly). Custom plans specific to the account are included when authenticated.

tools.name: list_logs
tools.description: List recent conversion logs for the account.

tools.name: get_log
tools.description: Get a single conversion log by its request id.
